thesis: The podcast discusses the origin and capabilities of Codex, OpenAI's coding agent, which functions as a cloud-based teammate that works on a developer's computer to write code and submit pull requests. The speakers explain that Codex was developed by combining reasoning models with tool access, specifically a terminal, to allow the agent to edit code directly rather than just completing lines of text. They highlight that Codex has opened approximately 400,000 pull requests in 34 days with an 80% merge rate, significantly outperforming other autonomous agents which typically merge at 20% to 30%.
